calls.summary: Priscilla Hwang called to compare the Saatva Classic against the Loom hybrid before buying a king. Oscar walked her through the dual-coil support and Euro pillow-top, then booked her a Viewing Room visit to feel the firmness in person. She left delighted and confirmed the appointment time.

Marcus Delaney wanted a cooling option and asked about the Latex Hybrid with organic natural latex over pocketed coils. Lila explained the 365-night home trial and scheduled a Viewing Room visit near his home. He was thrilled with the setup and free delivery details.

Gloria Simmons called for the delivery status of her Saatva Adjustable Base Plus and asked about pairing it with her mattress. Rosey confirmed the shipping window and reviewed the massage and lighting features on the adjustable base. No new visit was booked since this was an existing order.

First-time caller Daniel Whitfield reached out to plan a Saatva Classic purchase and wanted to try it before deciding. Mary collected his name, email, and preferred location, then walked him through sizing and financing. She booked a new Viewing Room visit and confirmed his contact details for the follow-up.

Angela Ruiz asked about the flippable Zenhaven and its two firmness options in natural latex. Lee described the dual-sided design and cooling benefits, then scheduled a Viewing Room visit so she could test both sides. She was happy to confirm the time.

Todd Barrera called with a warranty question about a sagging edge on his older Saatva HD. Mike explained the lifetime warranty coverage and started an inspection request. Todd remained on his existing order, so no visit was scheduled.

Nina Caldwell wanted to add the Organic Sateen Sheet Set and see fabric colors in person. Jennifer described the GOTS-certified cotton sateen and deep-pocket fitted sheet, then booked a Viewing Room visit. Nina confirmed the appointment before hanging up.

Robert Alvarez was frustrated that his delivery window shifted twice and wanted a firm date. Sue apologized, tracked the shipment, and escalated the delivery to the logistics team. The issue was open at the end of the call and no visit was booked.

Karen Foster asked whether an adjustable base would fit her current bed frame before upgrading. Rose confirmed compatibility and booked a Viewing Room visit to demo the articulation and massage settings. Karen agreed to the scheduled time.

Victor Long disputed an Affirm financing charge that did not match his quoted total. Oscar reviewed the order and opened a billing correction case. Victor stayed unhappy and no new visit was scheduled.

Denise Park called about a warranty claim for a defective seam on her mattress topper. Lila collected photos and filed the warranty request, but the resolution timeline upset her. She kept her existing order and did not book a visit.

Sofia Grant wanted to feel the Saatva Latex Pillow and matching sheet options before ordering. Lee described the shredded latex core and organic cotton cover, then booked a Viewing Room visit despite some hesitation over pricing. She confirmed the appointment.

Henry Osei called to cancel his Contour5 order after finding a longer delivery estimate than expected. Mike processed the cancellation and confirmed the refund window. Henry declined a Viewing Room visit and ended the call annoyed.

Beatrice Nolan called after hours to complain about a missed setup crew and left a voicemail. The message went unanswered by an agent and rolled to the queue. No visit was booked and the delivery complaint remained open.

Frank Delgado was upset that his warranty claim on a squeaky adjustable base was still pending. Sue reviewed the case notes and re-escalated it, but could not give a same-day fix. Frank stayed dissatisfied and did not schedule a visit.

qaPairs.question: What is the difference between the Saatva Classic and the Saatva Rx?
qaPairs.answer: The Classic is our flagship innerspring hybrid with a Euro pillow-top and dual-coil support, while the Rx is a memory foam hybrid engineered specifically for chronic and severe back pain. A Viewing Room visit lets you compare both in person, and I would be glad to book that for you.

qaPairs.question: Which mattress is best for back pain?
qaPairs.answer: Many customers with back concerns choose the Saatva Rx or the Saatva Classic for their targeted support. The best fit really depends on your body and sleep style, so I recommend a Viewing Room visit with a sleep specialist to confirm.

qaPairs.question: Do you have a cooling mattress?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our top cooling picks include the Saatva Latex Hybrid, the Contour5 all-foam, and the Memory Foam Hybrid. A specialist can help you feel the difference during a Viewing Room visit if you would like me to schedule one.

qaPairs.question: Are Saatva mattresses made in the USA?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, every Saatva mattress is made fresh to order and assembled in the U.S. with globally-sourced premium materials. You can experience the craftsmanship firsthand at a Viewing Room, and I can help you book a time.

qaPairs.question: What sizes do you offer?
qaPairs.answer: We offer twin, twin XL, full, queen, king, California king, and split king across our mattress lineup. Let me know your size and I can help you plan a Viewing Room visit to try it.

qaPairs.question: How much does the Saatva Classic cost?
qaPairs.answer: Pricing varies by size and current promotions, so I would rather give you an accurate figure than a rough guess. If you share your size and ZIP code, I can arrange a Viewing Room visit where a specialist confirms exact pricing.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer financing?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we offer financing through Affirm so you can spread payments over time. A specialist can walk you through the options at your Viewing Room visit, which I am happy to schedule.

qaPairs.question: What is the home trial period?
qaPairs.answer: Every Saatva mattress comes with a 365-night home trial so you can be sure it is right for you. I can share more details and set up a Viewing Room visit so you can feel it before you decide.

qaPairs.question: Is delivery and setup included?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we include free white glove delivery and setup plus free removal of your old mattress. Let me confirm your ZIP code and I can help you plan the next steps with a Viewing Room visit.

qaPairs.question: Do you have an organic mattress?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, the Zenhaven and the Saatva Latex Hybrid use organic natural latex, and Zenhaven is dual-sided with two firmness options. A Viewing Room visit is a great way to compare them, and I can book that for you.

qaPairs.question: What is the warranty on a Saatva mattress?
qaPairs.answer: Every Saatva mattress is backed by a lifetime warranty for lasting peace of mind. A specialist can explain the coverage in detail during a Viewing Room visit if you would like me to schedule one.

qaPairs.question: Do you have a mattress for heavier body types?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, the Saatva HD is a heavy-duty hybrid built for higher body weights with reinforced edge support. I recommend trying it at a Viewing Room, and I can help you find a time.

qaPairs.question: Can I adjust the firmness of the mattress?
qaPairs.answer: The Solaire is our adjustable air mattress with 50 precise firmness settings on each side. A Viewing Room visit lets you experience the settings in person, and I would be glad to book it.

qaPairs.question: Where is my nearest Viewing Room?
qaPairs.answer: We have Viewing Rooms in many major metro areas, and I can find the closest one if you share your ZIP code. From there I can help you schedule your visit.

qaPairs.question: Do you sell bed frames and bases?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we offer upholstered and wood bed frames like the Santorini, Amalfi, and Copenhagen, plus the Adjustable Base Plus with massage and lighting. You can see them at a Viewing Room, and I can set that up for you.

qaPairs.question: What bedding do you carry?
qaPairs.answer: We offer organic sateen sheet sets, latex pillows, and cooling graphite memory foam toppers among other items. A specialist can help you complete your setup during a Viewing Room visit.

qaPairs.question: Do you have any current sales?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our Labor Day Sale currently takes up to $625 off select mattresses. I can help you lock in the timing with a Viewing Room visit, so would you like me to find a slot?

qaPairs.question: What is a bundle?
qaPairs.answer: Our bundles pair a mattress with bedding or a base at a discount versus buying separately, including options like the Classic Bundle and the Back Pain Bundle. A specialist can tailor a bundle for you at a Viewing Room visit.

qaPairs.question: How is Saatva cheaper than other luxury brands?
qaPairs.answer: We cut out the middlemen with our direct-to-consumer model, so you get the highest quality at the best possible value. You can feel that quality for yourself at a Viewing Room, and I can help you book a time.

qaPairs.question: How long does a Saatva mattress last?
qaPairs.answer: Our handcrafted mattresses are built for durability and backed by a lifetime warranty. A specialist can talk through longevity for your chosen model at a Viewing Room visit, which I am happy to schedule.

voiceRoutingDemo.routedSubtitle: AI Agent qualified caller intent and matched to the right team

signalManager.title: Signal
signalManager.uploadBody: Go here to upload Signal and/or revenue amounts to Invoca calls
signalManager.apiBody: Learn about how to post Signals and revenue from another system

signals.name: Viewing Room Visit Booked (Conversion)
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["let me book your viewing room visit (Agent)", "I'd like to come in and try it (Caller)", "schedule your showroom appointment (Agent)", "reserve a time to lie on the mattress"])

signals.name: 365-Night Trial Objection Raised
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["what if I don't like the mattress (Caller)", "can I really return it after a year (Caller)", "is the home trial free (Caller)", "do you charge for mattress removal"])

signals.name: Adjustable Base Upsell Interest
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["tell me about the adjustable base plus (Caller)", "does it have massage and lighting (Caller)", "can I raise the head and foot (Caller)", "add the motorized base to my order (Agent)"])

signals.name: Back Pain Relief Mattress Interest
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["best mattress for back pain (Caller)", "I have chronic back pain (Caller)", "the Saatva Rx for lower back (Agent)", "something for my herniated disc"])

signals.name: Competitor Mattress Mentioned
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["I was looking at Purple (Caller)", "how does this compare to Tempur-Pedic (Caller)", "Casper had a cheaper price (Caller)", "we're better value than a showroom brand (Agent)"])

signals.name: Empathy And Rapport Score
signals.rules: scorecard[Empathy And Rapport] < 60 and duration > 45 sec

signals.name: Quote Provided
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["the sale price for a king is (Agent)", "with the Labor Day discount that comes to (Agent)", "let me quote you the Saatva Classic (Agent)", "your total with financing would be"]) and answered_by_agent

signals.name: Sleep Trial Terms Explained
signals.rules: scorecard[Trial And Warranty Coverage] < 60 and duration > 45 sec

signals.name: Viewing Room Visit Discussed (Industry)
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["do you have a viewing room near me (Caller)", "where can I try the mattress in person (Caller)", "we have a viewing room in your area (Agent)", "come see it before you buy"])

signals.name: Warm Call Opening
signals.rules: scorecard[Call Opening Compliance] < 60 and duration > 30 sec
